name: Time
languages: all those of the creature who summoned it

traits.name: The Law of Time
traits.text:
Enemies within 15 feet cannot
take bonus actions or reactions.

traits.name: Chaos Vulnerability
traits.text:
The Inexorables have disadvantage
on all saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Inexorable
traits.text:
The Inexorables are immune to any
effects that would slow them or deny them
actions or movement.

traits.name: Time Is Inexorable (Recharge 6)
traits.text:
At the end of
the round, after all creatures have acted, Time
takes another turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach
10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning
damage.

actions.name: Haste (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
Until the end of its next
turn, Time magically gains a +2 bonus to its AC,
has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and
can use its slam attack as a bonus action.
